I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-random. I said I'd noted that the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is 19 November, and that I hadn't changed or posted anything else. I also saved the correction in the workspace brain (gbrain), under Thornbury Cloth Co., noting where it came from. A deadline date is an account fact, not a money figure, so I could record and repeat it.

My reply also told Marcus that his #north-team message "still shows the old date," but I didn't actually read that channel, so I don't know it's true. I only assumed the earlier post hadn't been edited. If you want, I can post a short follow-up in his thread that rephrases it as a suggestion to check.
